prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 15 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1412; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a collision sustained while the vehicle was turning left, when the patient's vehicle was struck from the side. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported knee injury in both kind and force. Over the course of fifteen visits, care followed a conventional progression, with frequency of visits reducing steadily as symptoms improved and range of motion returned. Examination findings support a soft tissue injury to the knee, with localized tenderness and reduced flexion on initial assessment, while several other tests, including ligament stability and neurovascular checks, were within normal limits. No prior injury to the same body region has been reported or identified in the available history. Treatment charges reflect single billing for each service rendered, with no duplicate or repeated entries. Current status indicates substantial improvement, and the patient has been discharged from active care with instructions for home exercise and follow-up as needed.
